method: concurrent probes (24 workers, 10s timeout) of every URL referenced by the two public indexes

interop.finding: one duplicate slug in the index (probe set dedup'd) — generator should dedup; not a live door issue

verdict: ZERO silent-404 doors in the well-known and interop layers (the class of bug the estate has most to lose from). Doors that are intentionally unavailable answer 503/400 with lifecycle+reason (e.g. /api/witness).
principle: Every referenced URL answered at probe time; failures would have been recorded with their status, not hidden.
